about: Where containers appear. Anchors are every Site of Grace in the game (BonfireWarpParam rows hold each grace's map tile and position), so placement covers the whole game, DLC included, without a hand-made list. Each container is keyed by grace id + index so it stays searched in the mod's save sidecar.

columns.anchor: what a container is placed next to: grace
columns.chance: chance each one exists (deterministic per anchor+index)
columns.min_spacing_m: no two containers closer than this

_unverified_note: Grace positions are block-local; the chest is dropped onto the ground with a ray cast once its tile is loaded. Offsets need a look in game (not inside walls / off cliffs).
